transcript: It took me many years to understand this. I will not be here to repeat it. So listen carefully. Speak less. When words are rare, they carry weight. Do not take everything into your heart. Most people are lost in their own minds, not thinking about you as much as you imagine. Where your attention rests, your life follows. Feed problems and they multiply. Feed possibilities and doors begin to open. What hurts you now will one day make sense. Pain is often the cost of becoming someone stronger than you were before. No one enters your life by mistake. Some arrive to stay and soften your path. Others come only to teach you what you must never forget. Receive both with awareness. Keep the blessing. Learn from the lesson. This is how a better life is built. Quietly, slowly, from the inside. If you want the free seven-day guide to quiet your mind and reconnect with yourself, comment free and I'll send it to you.
